name: Asymptotic Maximum-Parent Auxiliary Rate
definition: For a nonempty proper maximum-generated class $C$, $\gamma(C)=\lim_{k\to\infty}a(C^k)/k=\inf_{k\ge1}b(C^k)/k$.
normalization: Cartesian powers use disjoint copies of the positioned visible ground; auxiliary coordinates are divided by the number of factors.
comments: The limit exists by subadditivity of $b(C^k)$ and $0\le b(C^k)-a(C^k)\le m(C)$. Always $\operatorname{VC}(C)\le\gamma(C)\le b(C)$.
